initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed difference is 0.10 − 0.20 = −0.10. Arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Request the archived design record R211-1 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R211-1 establishes randomized assignment independent of potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference. Thus the causal risk difference equals the observed population contrast: 8/80 − 24/120 = −0.10.
